response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced and technically versatile senior/staff engineer with genuine developer-tooling credentials (test runners, CI/CD setup, build infrastructure) and mobile platform exposure, but his resume shows no evidence of people management, direct reports, performance reviews, or team leadership — the core requirement of this Engineering Manager role. His career path is consistently individual-contributor across 15+ years, making the leap to a people-leadership title a significant gap rather than a natural next step.
strengths: Deep, broad technical expertise spanning web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure
Direct experience building developer tools (test runners, CI/CD, assertion libraries) aligning with the role's productivity focus
Mobile platform experience (iOS/Apple TV) matching the preferred qualification
concerns: No evidence of formal people management, one-on-ones, or performance feedback responsibilities
No indication of leading organizational change or managing teams at scale
Career history is entirely IC-track despite 15+ years experience, suggesting no proven managerial trajectory

key_factors.factor: Strong developer tooling and build/test infrastructure background
